listing.name: [0.98a] Vanilla Illustrations Remaster v1.0.0
listing.summary: Adds high-fidelity remastered versions of all 99 base game illustrations with enhanced detail and visual consistency.
listing.aiSummary: Adds high-fidelity remastered versions of all 99 base game illustrations with enhanced detail and visual consistency.

description:
[0.98a] Vanilla Illustrations Remaster v1.0.0

This mod is a complete, high-fidelity visual overhaul of the 99 base game illustrations. The vanilla designs have been remastered to look sharper and more detailed, while keeping with the original illustration's overall design and theme.

All images are downscaled from high resolution masters, to 640x400 pixels, using Lanczos resampling.

Asset Disclosure:

The base lighting, composition, and raw textures for these portraits were generated using Nano Banana 2. The original vanilla illustrations were used as direct visual references for each new image. They were then manually edited, corrected and polished by hand with Paint.NET to fix errors or alter the final result.

As a note, some illustrations had to be made into unique images using custom prompts. This was due to the (frustrating) limitations of Nano Banana 2 and hitting rather solid walls with multiple attempts to enhance the base game images and keep the level of quality somewhat consistent. So I did my absolute best to create something based around the original illustration's theme, that was visually interesting and was representative of the original image.

Click to view the full illustration showcase image

[close](The preview image is a lower resolution than the in-game illustrations)

Download from Google Drive

Installation:

1. Download and extract the ZIP file.

2. Drop the main folder directly into your Starsector/mods/ directory.

3. Enable "Vanilla Illustrations Remaster" in the game launcher mod list.

Didn't really stop after the portraits and went straight into it, with the illustrations. Hope you like them! ;D
